title: The games' official covers
description: Each game's official cover and artwork on IGDB, and its genre and summary there, written by catalog/tools/igdb_covers.py: IGDB's game and image IDs only, never an address. The launcher builds the images' addresses itself.

titleId.description: The game's title ID in nxnative.json.

name.description: IGDB's name of the game, to check the match by eye.

artwork.description: An artwork of the game, wide.

genre.description: The game's genre on IGDB, as one of Cartouche's own: the launcher shows it for a game whose nxnative profile says none.

summary.description: The game's summary on IGDB, in English, with its spaces made plain, cut after a word with an ellipsis past 2,000 characters: the launcher shows it on the game's sheet, translated by the iPhone.
